Prince Philip, Duke of Edinburgh, was the husband of Queen Elizabeth II. He served as the British royal consort from Elizabeth's ascension on February 6, 1952 until his death on April 9, 2021. He is the father of King Charles III, Princess Anne, Prince Andrew and Prince Edward.

As husband to Queen Elizabeth II, he served as royal consort from 1952 to 2021- the longest in British history. This footage captures a poignant moment, his final official engagement at Buckingham Palace, marking the end of 65 years of royal service. A lifetime of loyalty. A legacy of service.
